cena: Mr. Okafor chega com dor lombar. A Dra. Caroline localiza a dor no corpo: que lado, se irradia, se piora ao mover — tudo em inglês, apontando e perguntando.
gramatica: O verbo to hurt, a pergunta Does it hurt? e as preposições que localizam a dor no corpo.

imagem.alt: Um homem sentado na maca aponta para a região lombar enquanto a médica, de jaleco, observa com a mão apoiada nas costas dele.
imagem.prompt: Warm, friendly 2D vector illustration, flat modern style with soft shading. Inside a medical examination room. A man in his forties sits sideways on an examination couch, reaching back with one hand to point at his lower back, face showing mild discomfort. A woman doctor in a white coat over teal scrubs stands beside him, one hand gently resting on his back, leaning in to look where he points. On the wall behind: a simple anatomical poster of a human figure with no writing on it. Limited palette of teal, cyan, warm sand and deep navy. Clean shapes, soft shadows. No text, no letters, no words, no numbers anywhere in the image.

linhas.en: Does it hurt on this side?
Does the pain go down your leg?
linhas.pt: A dor desce pela sua perna?
O senhor consegue dobrar o joelho?

linhas.en: Sorry. Tell me if it hurts.
Does it hurt when you move?
linhas.pt: Dói quando o senhor se move?

linhas.en: Yes, when I lift my arm.
linhas.pt: Sim, quando eu levanto o braço.

linhas.en: Let's look at your back now.
linhas.pt: Vamos olhar as suas costas agora.
